areas.capability: ranex CLI: gate evaluate, journal verify, run, host, suite freeze, deps fetch/approve, keygen, specification, task dispatch/judge/merge/delegate/fanout/batch
SQLite hash-chained append-only journal; UPDATE/DELETE refused by triggers; verify() recomputes the chain and detects out-of-band edits; append_if_head CAS
Ed25519 evidence signing over exactly ten canonical SIGNED_FIELDS, domain ranex-evidence-v4; verify returns False, never raises
admit() splits raw records into evidence + structured rejections (malformed/missing-signature/bad-signature/unknown-producer/stale-host-state); unknown producers are never trusted by default
Pure gate evaluation: absence blocks, contradiction blocks, self-approval refused before evidence is considered, stale subject digests prove nothing
Frozen suite manifests from observed junitxml IDs only; results summarised as counts/non_passed/missing/extra_count/outcome_digest against the manifest
Canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact, no NaN) and command_digest over the argv list so argument order is structural
Producer keypair generation into $RANEX_SIGNING_KEY; refuses relative paths and paths committable into the repository; refuses overwriting an existing key

Pinned resolver (O_NOFOLLOW, hashed fd, executed via /proc/self/fd), lock re-derivation with byte-equality refusal, strict TOML lock parse, content-addressed wheel store, sealed disposable root; deps fetch is the only networked step

Native C launcher: two-stage exec fd protocol, Landlock >= 6, seccomp, mount namespaces, minimal /dev, capability drop, unprivileged userns, cgroup enroll/kill/wait-empty; v3 sealed-fd runtime (memfd F_ADD_SEALS); static-executable admission (ELF64 ET_EXEC, no PT_DYNAMIC/PT_INTERP)

Clarification lifecycle DRAFT -> SPEC_VALIDATED -> TESTS_MAPPED -> APPROVAL_PENDING binding spec packet (A), generated artifact manifest (B), approval envelope (C) by digest; closed ranex-scenario-v1 DSL compiled to deterministic gauges/projections with negative controls
Frozen 11-field trace schema with refusal-not-truncation caps; positive-allowlist redaction; git-trace2-style chained session IDs; redacted retained logs with PEM/credential-URL over-matching

Committed YAML trust root: producer -> Ed25519 public key with duplicate-key refusal and one-key-one-producer; verdict signer must not alias a producer; YAML gate catalog binding claim_id to exact digested argv
